meta.title: AutoXpert — car parts from several vendors
meta.description: Compare and order parts that fit your vehicle, from several vendors, in one place.

nav.welcome: Parts catalogue for drivers in Quebec

home.title: Find a part that matches the vehicle you drive.
home.lead: Choose the year, make, model and engine. AutoXpert then compares offers from NAPA, Canadian Tire, PartSource and our warehouse.
home.howBody: Each product page shows the best in-stock price, then the other vendors. You order in one place; the supplier stays on the receipt.
home.trustBody: Lead times here are prototype estimates. Taxes, live freight and payment are not wired in this version.
home.vehicleNeeded: Select a vehicle to filter the catalogue.
home.slide2Kicker: A counter mechanic, in the browser
home.slide2Title: Marc compares offers and fitment before you order.
home.slide2Lead: Describe the noise, the part or the service interval. Chat stays on this page, next to the vehicle picker.
home.marquee1: NAPA, Canadian Tire, PartSource and the AutoXpert warehouse
home.marquee2: Filter by year, make, model and engine
home.aboutTitle: How AutoXpert brings together catalogues from several vendors.
home.aboutBody: Each product page shows the best in-stock price, then the other vendors. You order in one place; the supplier stays on the receipt.
home.aboutPoint1Text: Year, make, model and engine filter the catalogue before prices appear.
home.aboutPoint2Text: Marc answers from the catalogue and the selected vehicle, without shop slogans.
home.serviceCard: Offers from several vendors, for the selected vehicle.
home.whyTitle: Delivery in Quebec and pickup at the listed vendor.
home.marcBody: Ask about a part, a noise or a service interval. Answers stay tied to the catalogue.
home.check1: Filter by year, make, model and engine
home.check4: Delivery in Quebec or pickup at the vendor
home.needHelp: A parts question? Write to Marc from the home page.
